business_problem: Naturalis and the Arise initiative needed a practical way to interpret large volumes of insect acoustic data so conservation teams could track biodiversity change and identify species more effectively.
solution_summary: Naturalis worked with Capgemini and AWS through the 2023 Global Data Science Challenge to turn raw insect audio into an AI-assisted biodiversity monitoring workflow. The customer contributed biodiversity context and acoustic recordings from the Arise program, then challenge teams used Amazon SageMaker machine-learning services to develop and test species-classification models against five hours of recordings covering 66 insect species. The winning model identifies species from sound with about 92% accuracy, improving prior performance while giving conservation researchers a practical starting point for automated monitoring. Capgemini used the challenge to orchestrate experimentation, published the results afterward, and is continuing development with Naturalis and AWS so other biodiversity organizations can reuse and extend the approach.
